title: 最大连续 NaN 次数

standard.summary: 连续检测到多少次 NaN/Inf loss 后强制停止训练。默认 3。
standard.effect: 设为 1 = 首次 NaN 立即停止（最严格）；设为 10 = 允许偶发 NaN 继续，仅持续 NaN 时停止。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 3 适合大多数场景。使用 FP16 且 NaN 偶发概率较高时可提高到 5~10。
standard.avoidWhen: 不建议设为 0（不停止）或过大（掩盖真实崩溃）。

standard_en.summary: How many consecutive NaN/Inf losses force training to stop. Default 3.
standard_en.effect: 1 = stop the moment the first NaN appears (the strictest); 10 = tolerate the occasional NaN and only stop on a sustained run of them.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default 3 suits most cases. With FP16, where the odd NaN is fairly likely, you can raise it to 5~10.
standard_en.avoidWhen: 0 is not advisable (never stops), nor is a very large value (it masks a real collapse).

advanced.principle: 维护连续 NaN 计数器：正常步归零，触发时递增，超过阈值抛出 SafeGuardException 终止训练。
advanced.tradeoffs: 设置过低（=1）可能因混合精度偶发数值噪声误触发；设置过高则真实崩溃时浪费更多 GPU 时间。

advanced_en.principle: Maintains a consecutive-NaN counter: reset to zero on normal steps, incremented on trigger; past the threshold it throws SafeGuardException to terminate training.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Too low a setting (=1) can misfire from occasional mixed-precision numerical noise; too high a setting wastes more GPU time when a real crash happens.
